questions.prompt: Which statement gives the core rule for “ADC, PWM, and analog input”?
options: Peripheral and pin mappings depend on the board's MCU.
PWM duty cycle controls the fraction of time the output is high.
Compile and upload are separate; a successful build does not guarantee the selected port is correct.
Do not assume Arduino UNO pin mappings apply to a different MCU family.
questions.answer: PWM duty cycle controls the fraction of time the output is high.
questions.explanation:
PWM duty cycle controls the fraction of time the output is high.
Why: An ADC converts voltage to a digital value with board-specific range and resolution. PWM modulates a digital output; it is not necessarily a true DAC.
